slides.title: The Most Useful Endpoints 🔍
slides.content:
# Common Endpoints

| Endpoint | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `/health` | Shows application health (UP/DOWN) with details. |
| `/info` | Displays custom application information. |
| `/metrics` | Provides various metrics (memory, threads, HTTP requests). |
| `/env` | Exposes environment properties (be careful with security!). |
| `/beans` | Lists all Spring beans in the context. |
| `/mappings` | Shows all URL mappings. |
| `/loggers` | Allows viewing and changing log levels at runtime. |

quizData.question: Which endpoint would you use to see the current memory usage?
quizData.explanation: /metrics provides runtime metrics including memory, heap, threads, and custom metrics.

slides.title: Accessing Specific Metrics
slides.content:
You can drill into specific metrics by appending the metric name:

`GET /actuator/metrics/jvm.memory.used`

This returns the current value of that metric.

slides.title: Be Careful with /env
slides.content: The `/env` endpoint can expose sensitive configuration (like passwords). In production, restrict access via security or disable it.
